Sichtweite auf der Landebahn

The distance over which a pilot of an aircraft on the centre line of a runway can see the runway surface markings or lights.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Sichtweite auf der Landebahn?

In this glossary, Sichtweite auf der Landebahn refers to: The distance over which a pilot of an aircraft on the centre line of a runway can see the runway surface markings or lights.

How is Sichtweite auf der Landebahn used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sichtweite auf der Landebahn 400 Meter gemeldet, zur Landung freigegeben."

Why does Sichtweite auf der Landebahn matter in aviation?

Sichtweite auf der Landebahn matters because it supports clear communication in Aircraft Systems contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Sichtweite auf der Landebahn is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.
